scenarios.name: SP1-CRITIC-01 critic produces a valid CriticFindings model

steps.text: an LLM that returns a valid CriticFindings JSON with gaps and checklist results
the completeness critic is run
a CriticFindings model is produced
the model has a gaps list, checklist_results dict, and taxonomy_probe_results dict

scenarios.name: SP1-CRITIC-02 critic with no gaps produces empty gaps list

steps.text: an LLM that returns a CriticFindings JSON with an empty gaps list
the completeness critic is run
the CriticFindings gaps list is empty
an LLM that returns a CriticFindings JSON with a gap of type <gap_type>
the completeness critic is run
the CriticFindings model contains a gap with gap_type <gap_type>

scenarios.name: SP1-CRITIC-04 gap with invalid type fails validation

steps.text: an LLM that returns a CriticFindings JSON with a gap of type missing_tool
the completeness critic is run
validation fails with error containing gap_type

scenarios.name: SP1-CRITIC-05 each gap has description, related_attack_path, and suggested_remedy

steps.text: an LLM that returns a CriticFindings JSON with a gap having all required fields
the completeness critic is run
the gap has a description, related_attack_path, and suggested_remedy

scenarios.name: SP1-CRITIC-06 checklist results map responsibility names to status

steps.text: an LLM that returns a CriticFindings JSON with checklist results
the completeness critic is run
the checklist_results map responsibility names to present, absent_justified, or absent_unjustified

scenarios.name: SP1-CRITIC-07 critic call is logged with stage stage_2 and step critic

steps.text: an LLM that returns a valid CriticFindings JSON
a run directory for call logging
the completeness critic is run
a call log entry is appended with stage stage_2
the call log entry step is critic

scenarios.name: SP1-CRITIC-08 critic receives control structure, capability profile, and use-case

steps.text: an LLM that returns a valid CriticFindings JSON
the completeness critic is run
the user prompt contains the control structure
the user prompt contains the capability profile
the user prompt contains the use-case text

scenarios.name: SP1-CRITIC-09 taxonomy probes are conditioned on capability profile

steps.text: a capability profile with KC sub-code KC6.3.3 indicating RAG
an LLM that returns a valid CriticFindings JSON
the completeness critic is run
the user prompt contains taxonomy-derived probes for RAG retrieval integrity
an LLM that returns a CriticFindings JSON with an absent_unjustified checklist result
the completeness critic is run
revision is triggered

scenarios.name: SP1-CRITIC-11 only justified gaps do not trigger revision

steps.text: an LLM that returns a CriticFindings JSON with all checklist results as absent_justified or present
the completeness critic is run
revision is not triggered

scenarios.name: SP1-CRITIC-12 critic findings are recorded in the run manifest

steps.text: an LLM that returns a CriticFindings JSON with two gaps
the completeness critic is run
the run manifest critic_findings contains two entries

background.text: the STPA system model critic module is importable
a control structure with responsibilities RESP-1 and RESP-2 is available
a capability profile and use-case text are available
